scope.audio_read: Only last up to 1 second of the exact 13 selected WAVs; no other corpus/heldout/qualification audio.

diagnosis.conclusion: No decoder event was admitted; no event was suppressed by the refractory window.
diagnosis.basis: All decoder_hits, refractory_suppressed, and detections counters are zero. Engine counts decoder hit before refractory filtering.

diagnosis.conclusion: Final-confirm, trailing-blank wait, and grace/lookahead policy do not explain this run.
diagnosis.basis: Both keywords use immediate policy, zero min_trailing_blanks and zero grace. Eligible terminals emit in the same decoder step. No separately configurable lookahead or min_score exists in this runtime; the confidence threshold is pack.threshold (0.55), separate from the -16 path-retention gate.

diagnosis.conclusion: All-blank-top1 acoustic output is a decisive failure mechanism for six clips under the current four-token decoder policy.
diagnosis.confidence: deduced from counters plus exact source
diagnosis.basis: Every depth-4 path must take three non-root child advances. If every frame is blank-top1, each advance is non-top and adds -8.25 retention cost. Their combined cost is at most -24.75 before additional decay, below the required -16. Root may also be blocked if its blank-to-root gap exceeds 0.5. Thus threshold-only lowering cannot rescue these all-blank clips with unchanged search policy.

diagnosis.conclusion: The seven clips with nonblank frames cannot yet be assigned to missing/wrong token sequence, root-start exclusion, retention failure, VAD-at-terminal failure, or confidence-threshold failure.
diagnosis.basis: Counters omit token identities/order, logit gaps, trie depths, terminal confidence, and terminal gate history. Nonblank argmax is not evidence of the complete target sequence.

diagnosis.conclusion: A total speech-gate failure is ruled out, but speech gating at the relevant terminal frame is still unknown.
diagnosis.basis: 879 speech-active frames, and every clip has some; the speech flag is an RMS energy gate, not a speech recognizer or feature-quality check. It is required at terminal admission.

diagnosis.conclusion: The runner has no EOF flush, but omission of a conventional zero-padded tail flush cannot release a final-confirm event for these inputs and pack.
diagnosis.confidence: static source plus tail-energy deduction; no padding experiment performed
diagnosis.basis: Every clip leaves 240 new samples (15 ms), plus 80 overlap samples, in a partial 400-sample frame. Its buffered last 320 samples are all below -55 dBFS. Completing that frame with 80 zeros makes it VAD-inactive, as would all later zero-only frames. This pack has no pending or immediate trailing-blank wait and cannot newly qualify a terminal on a VAD-inactive frame. This does not judge whether TTS speech was clipped before the existing file tail.

remaining_unknowns: Whether frontend features are collapsed, inappropriate for this audio domain, or otherwise mismatched; blank-top1 counters cannot distinguish a feature problem from acoustic-model behavior.
